findings.title: Old straight-mullion count is not included in drift preflight
findings.evidence: Removing one straight-mullion in the sixth baseline window still lets fitNingshouSouthPhotoWindows complete. The helper preflights six backing meshes and four frames/two crossbars per row, but not the old vertical bars.
findings.impact: Defensive guard/test coverage only. Current frozen R66 host and R67 output are exact and all explicit target-preservation tests pass. No present visual or physics defect found.
findings.suggestion: Optionally require expected straight-mullion count/locations per row and add a last-bay missing-mullion atomic negative test before a future shared-panel change. Safe to defer.

scopeChecks.ningshou: Six south closed bays only. Backings/colliders, east secondary doorway+sidelights, rear, roof, other geometry, walkables, rooms/maps/regions are byte/semantic exact against R66 outside target bars. Three upper transom/lower-leaf metadata agrees with generated divisions. Red frame color is a fitted approximation, not measured paint.
scopeChecks.jingqi: frontPattern defaults to pattern, and upperFrontPattern defaults to pattern. Only Jingqi opts into upperFrontPattern=steps. Ground glass and upper rear/side output remain exact; upper south backing geometry is retained while glass becomes paper behind the simplified step lattice. Stair/stage/floor/physics unchanged apart from dedicated furniture colliders.
scopeChecks.yueshi: sourceVerge defaults false and only Yueshi enables it. Two green curved closed FrontSide shells, 196 triangles each, positive signed volume about 0.10890008, minimum triangle area about 0.00495000, every topological edge has two opposite directed uses. Decorative overlay adds no support or collision and makes no exact tile/hip-corner ornament claim.
scopeChecks.changyin: Only changyin-ground-perimeter-rail and changyin-upper-stage-rail material references are replaced with owned red material. No shared material color mutation. Other rail/guard/stair roles and geometric shapes retained.
scopeChecks.actorsAndRoutes: No actor or path source/data file differs between base and reviewed head. All 263 active source-manifest hashes match. Reviewer did not rerun 108/24 full-world population checks; that runtime gate remains the parent world verification responsibility.
